clinicalSummary.headline: Elevated Nocturnal Hypoglycemia Risk (54.2% calibrated probability)
clinicalSummary.operatingPointContext: Calibrated against 10.5% cohort prevalence. At 80% operational specificity, model PPV is 30.6% (NNW = 3.27, Alert Burden = 1.8 alerts/pt-week).
primaryDrivers: No personal history yet: calibrated risk estimated using acute CGM dynamics (Model B).
Low bedtime glucose entry point (66.6 mg/dL).
Rapid negative 3-hour glucose trajectory (-18.9 mg/dL/hr).
Concurrent exogenous insulin therapy increasing overnight vulnerability.
clinicalSummary.recommendedAction: Recommend immediate clinical review. Consider a bedtime complex carbohydrate snack (15-30g) and evaluate whether down-titration of bedtime secretagogue (none 0.0mg) is warranted.
